_provenance: Real capture: POST https://agent.co-legal.be/a2a/jsonrpc against a live production agent found via a2aregistry.org, 2026-07-07. Sent using the v0.3 method name 'message/send'; the server understood it (unlike helloworld/MolTrust, which reject unrecognized methods) but replied in pure v1.0 envelope/role shape -- confirmed a real, correct, substantive answer, distinct per skill/question. Motivated widening content_present_on_completion (formerly artifact_present_on_completion) to accept content in either status.message or artifacts: this agent never populates artifacts at all, only status.message, and was a false-negative under the old artifacts-only check.

parts.text: Het “basistarief” van de Belgische btw is het algemene btw-tarief dat geldt voor de meeste leveringen van goederen en diensten, tenzij een verlaagd tarief of vrijstelling van toepassing is.
